finding.summary: The git diff subprocess call doesn't check its return code. If 'since' is an invalid commit or git fails, stdout may be empty and label changes will be silently missed.
finding.fix: Check the return code of the git diff call and raise an error on failure, similar to how git show is handled.

label: real_issue
label_reason: Commit 02d37e7 in the PR cites finding R45-fee8a9a-021.
